cases.name: equation-without-definitions
cases.source: We minimize $$L(\theta) = \sum_i \ell(f_\theta(x_i), y_i) + \lambda R(\theta).$$ The optimization details are given in the next section.

result.translation: 我们最小化 $$L(\theta) = \sum_i \ell(f_\theta(x_i), y_i) + \lambda R(\theta).$$ 优化细节将在下一节给出。

cases.source: The next section presents the results. We then discuss the limitations and conclude the paper.
